_notes: Edit this file BEFORE prepare-model / prepare-model0 to control that logical model's search.
A prepared model freezes its candidate algorithms and representations in active_learning.db; later config edits do not retroactively change it.
models may be 'all', 'parent_winner', or an explicit list such as ['xgb', 'rf', 'lgbm'].
representations may contain any non-empty subset of ['global_molecular', 'position_resolved'].
The default is deliberately broad: all 8 algorithms and both representations. Narrow individual logical models whenever justified.
C uses 5 top + 5 nearest eligible prediction-range midpoint + 5 bottom; E uses 7 top + 4 midpoint + 4 bottom.
Model1F is the single shared pooled A-E Cycle-1 seed. There is intentionally no Model1G because it would duplicate Model1F.
For n>=2, Model<n>F trains on cumulative canonical A-E acquisitions through cycle n PLUS canonical F acquisitions from cycles < n; F therefore learns from its own discoveries.
For n>=2, Model<n>G trains on cumulative canonical A-E acquisitions through cycle n ONLY; G selections never feed back and provide the pooled no-self-feedback control.
F and G each select 15 highest predicted-DDAPL candidates after their own model is trained and prediction-complete; use select-f or select-g respectively.
H is reserved for a future active strategy and currently has no selection/training definition.

X/Y preserve the old zero-target C/E methodologies as historical/inactive methods. They remain available for retrospective/negative-region investigation but are not generated by normal future selection.
